l-m-h1-b0e01a-10.s.s1.r.a: (4+1)²=25 ya fi 4²+1=17 girma, saboda haka wannan misali ne da ya dace da ikirarin.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.goal: Bincika ko da'awar cewa ‘idan matrisoshi biyu ba O ba ne, samfurinsu AB ba O ba ne’ tana aiki kullum, sannan ka samo ka bayyana yanayin da ba ta aiki (misalin da ke karyata da'awar).
l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.material: O shi ne matrisin sifili wanda dukkan abubuwan cikinsa 0 ne. Da'awa: Idan A≠O kuma B≠O, to AB ma ba O ba ne. Nemo A da B da za su nuna cewa wannan da'awar ba daidai ba ce.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.s.s1.r.b: AB=(2 1; 4 3), wanda ba O ba ne. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da da'awar.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.s.s1.r.d: AB=(2 0; 0 3), wanda ba O ba ne. Wannan misali ne da ya dace da da'awar.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.s.s1.explain: Dukkan abubuwan da ke cikin (1 0; 0 0)(0 0; 0 1) su ne 0, saboda haka AB=O. A da B ba O ba ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-56.s.s2.model.0: A da B suna da abubuwan da ba 0 ba, amma duk abubuwan AB su ne 0, saboda haka AB=O, kuma wannan ya zama misalin da ke karyata da'awar.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-48.s.s2.model.0: Niba A=(0 1; 0 0), buri mwanya wa A² ni 0, ariko A ifite 1; bityo A≠O kandi ni urugero ruvuguruza.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-48.s.s2.model.1: Ku mibare, iyo kare ingana na 0, umubare na wo uba 0; ariko matrice ntizikora gutyo, bityo iyi A ivuguruza icyo gitekerezo.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-03.s.s1.o.d: Ko haruffa da ƙarfin kowane harafi iri ɗaya ne

l-m-h1-b0e01a-03.s.s2.model.0: x²y da xy² suna da haruffa iri ɗaya amma ƙarfin ya bambanta, don haka ba masu kama ba ne. Ma'aunin shi ne ko haruffa da ƙarfin su iri ɗaya ne.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.goal: Yanke shawarar bayanin (ma’aunin) da ake bukata da gaske don rarraba x²+7x+12, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.material: Kana son rarraba x²+7x+12 zuwa (x+p)(x+q). Wane bayani ya kamata ka yi la’akari da shi don nemo p da q?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.prompt: Wane sharadi ake bukata da gaske don nemo p da q?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.o.a: Lambobi biyu da ninkawarsu 7 ce, jimillarsu kuma 12
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.r.a: An musanya ninkawa da jimilla. Ƙayyadadden kalma ita ce ninkawa.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.o.b: Mafi girman mai raba gama-gari na 7 da 12
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.r.b: Mafi girman mai raba gama-gari ba ya ƙayyade p da q.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.r.c: Abin da ake bukata ba yawan masu rabawa ba ne, sharuddan jimilla da ninkawa ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.o.d: Lambobi biyu da ninkawarsu 12 ce, jimillarsu kuma 7
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s1.explain: (x+p)(x+q)=x²+(p+q)x+pq, saboda haka p+q=7 da pq=12. p da q su ne 3 da 4.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s2.model.0: Faɗaɗawa yana bada x²+(p+q)x+pq; saboda haka ana bukatar lambobi biyu da suka cika pq=12 da p+q=7.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-13.s.s2.model.1: Ƙayyadadden kalma ita ce ninkawa, ma’aunin x kuma jimilla; saboda haka ka yi la’akari da ninkawa 12 da jimilla 7.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.title: Ta yaya za ka gane ko lissafi quadratic ne?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.goal: Yanke shawarar bayanin (ma’aunin) da ake bukata da gaske don gane ko lissafi quadratic ne, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.material: Wasu lissafi suna nuna x², kamar x²+3x=x²−5, wasu kuma ba su nuna x² ba. Kana son mayar da dukkan kalmomi gefe ɗaya sannan a sauƙaƙa.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.prompt: Wace ƙa’ida ce ke nuna ko quadratic ne?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.r.a: Idan aka sauƙaƙa x²+3x=x²−5, x² ya ɓace ya zama lissafi na mataki na farko.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.o.b: Ko x ya bayyana sau biyu ko fiye
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.r.b: Ko x ya bayyana sau da yawa, bayan sauƙaƙawa lissafin na iya zama mataki na farko.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.r.c: Idan akwai alamar daidaito, lissafi ne kawai, ba za a gane matakinsa ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.o.d: Ko kalmar x² ta rage bayan sauƙaƙawa
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s1.explain: Idan aka sauƙaƙa x²+3x=x²−5, ya zama 3x+5=0, saboda haka ba lissafin quadratic ba ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s2.model.0: A cikin x²+3x=x²−5, x² na gefuna biyu suna soke juna, ya zama 3x+5=0; saboda haka ba quadratic ba ne. Duba kalmar x² bayan sauƙaƙawa.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-19.s.s2.model.1: Ko da x² yana bayyana kafin sauƙaƙawa, yana iya ɓacewa; saboda haka a yanke shawara bisa ko x² ya rage bayan sauƙaƙawa.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.material: A matris ne na 2×3. Ana iya lissafa samfurin AB idan B matris ne na 3×1, amma ba idan B na 2×1 ba. Ka bayyana dalilin ta amfani da ma'aunin.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma'auni ne ke nuna cewa za a iya lissafa samfurin AB?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.o.a: Ko A da B suna da adadin abubuwa iri ɗaya
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.r.a: Adadin abubuwa ba shi da alaƙa da yiwuwar samun samfurin. Matrisoshi masu abubuwa 6 da 3 ma ana iya ninkawa.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.o.b: Ko adadin ginshiƙan A da adadin layukan B iri ɗaya ne
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.o.c: Ko adadin layukan A da adadin layukan B iri ɗaya ne
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.r.c: A cikin samfurin, ana haɗa ginshiƙan A da layukan B.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.o.d: Ko A da B suna da siffa iri ɗaya
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.r.d: Ba lallai siffofin su zama iri ɗaya ba. Ana iya ninka 2×3 da 3×1 ma.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s1.explain: Abubuwan AB suna samuwa ne ta hanyar haɗa layin A da ginshiƙin B sannan a ninka su; saboda haka adadin ginshiƙan A dole ya yi daidai da adadin layukan B.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s2.model.0: Dole adadin abubuwa a layi ɗaya na A ya yi daidai da adadin abubuwa a ginshiƙi ɗaya na B, domin a iya haɗa su sannan a ninka; wato adadin ginshiƙai da adadin layuka dole su yi daidai.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-57.s.s2.model.1: Ana iya ninka 2×3 da 3×1 domin ginshiƙai 3 na A sun yi daidai da layuka 3 na B, amma 2×1 ba ya aiki domin 3 da 2 ba iri ɗaya ba ne.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.title: Me ke ƙayyade digirin polinomial?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.goal: Ka gano wane ma'auni (bayanan da ake buƙata) ne yake da muhimmanci don nemo digirin polinomial 3x²y+xy³−5, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.material: Kana son ƙayyade digirin polinomial 3x²y+xy³−5. Akwai mabambantan x da y guda biyu, don haka dole ka yanke shawarar ƙimar da za ka yi amfani da ita a matsayin ma'auni.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma'auni ne ake amfani da shi wajen ƙayyade digiri?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.r.a: xy³ yana da digiri 4, jimlar ƙarfin x da na y. Idan ka duba x kawai, ba za ka lura da shi ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.r.b: Ƙididdiga 3 ba ta da alaƙa da digiri.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.o.c: Mafi girman ƙimar da ake samu ta hanyar tara dukkan ƙarfin mabambantan a kowace kalma
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.r.d: Ko da akwai kalmomi 3, digirin ba 3 ba ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s1.explain: x²y yana da digiri 2+1=3, kuma xy³ yana da digiri 1+3=4. Mafi girman ƙimar, 4, ita ce digirin polinomial.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s2.model.0: A tara dukkan ƙarfin mabambantan a cikin kalma ɗaya; saboda haka xy³ yana da digiri 4, kuma mafi girman ƙimar, 4, ita ce digiri.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-03.s.s2.model.1: Idan ka duba x kawai, ba za ka ga y³ a cikin xy³ ba; saboda haka ma'aunin shi ne mafi girman jimlar ƙarfin mabambantan.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.title: Me ya sa za a iya warware x²−9y² zuwa abubuwa amma ba x²+9y² ba?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.goal: Ka gano wane ma'auni (bayanin da ake buƙata) ne zai nuna ko za a iya warware furuci zuwa bambancin murabba'ai biyu, sannan ka bayyana dalilin zaɓinka.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.material: x²−9y² yana warwarewa zuwa (x+3y)(x−3y). Amma x²+9y² mai kama da shi ba za a iya warware shi ta wannan hanya ba. Nemo ma'aunin da ke bambanta su.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.prompt: Wane ma'auni ne ke nuna ko za a iya warware shi zuwa abubuwa?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.o.a: Ko yana da sifar bambanci (ragewa) tsakanin murabba'ai biyu
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.b: x²+9y² ma yana da kalmomi biyu, amma ba za a iya warware shi zuwa abubuwa ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.o.c: Ko dukkan ƙididdigai suna da kyau
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.c: Ma'aunin ba alamar ƙididdigai ba ce, a'a ko an rubuta shi ta hanyar ragewa ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.r.d: Ko da akwai nau'ikan mabambanta biyu, ba za a iya warware jimla zuwa abubuwa ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s1.explain: A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B); saboda haka dole ya kasance a sifar ragewa. Ba za a yi amfani da wannan dabara ga A²+B² ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.0: x²−9y² ni itandukaniro rya x² na (3y)², bityo ishobora kwandikwa nka (x+3y)(x−3y); ariko x²+9y² ni igiteranyo, bityo iri tegeko ntirikoreshwa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-04.s.s2.model.1: Itegeko A²−B²=(A+B)(A−B) rikoreshwa gusa iyo dukuramo; bityo igipimo ni ukumenya niba ari itandukaniro ry'ubusumbane bubiri.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-49.s.s1.r.d: Kumenya niba umubare ari impari ntibikenewe kugira ngo werekane matrice.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-49.s.s1.explain: Urugero, ugena ko imirongo ari amashuri, inkingi zikaba iminsi, kugira ngo umwanya umwe uhore usobanura kimwe kandi ubashe kubara.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.material: Kana son kayyade da'ira ɗaya ka rubuta daidaito (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r². Ka yi tunanin bayanin da ake buƙata domin nemo a, b da r.

l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.s.s1.r.c: Idan radius ya bambanta, akwai da'irori da yawa masu cibiya iri ɗaya.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.s.s1.r.d: Akwai da'irori marasa iyaka da ke ratsa maki guda.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.s.s1.explain: Idan ka san cibiyar (a, b) da radius r, za ka iya rubuta (x−a)²+(y−b)²=r².
l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.s.s2.model.0: A daidaiton, a da b su ne cibiyar, r kuma radius ne, saboda haka ana buƙatar waɗannan ƙimomi uku domin ƙayyade da'ira ɗaya.
l-m-h1-b0e02b-03.s.s2.model.1: Sanin radius kaɗai bai isa ba saboda cibiyar na iya kasancewa ko'ina; sanin cibiya kaɗai kuma ba ya nuna girma.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.goal: Nemo ka bayyana ƙa'ida daga misalai da dama na faɗaɗa (x+1)(x+n), sannan ka gwada ƙa'idar da sabon yanayi.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.material: (x+1)(x+2)=x²+3x+2, (x+1)(x+3)=x²+4x+3, (x+1)(x+4)=x²+5x+4. Nemo ƙa'idar ka yi amfani da ita ga sabon furuci.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s1.r.a: Ma'aunin ninkawa na kalmar x shi ne n+1, saboda haka 8 ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s1.r.b: An musanya ma'aunin ninkawa na x da ƙimar dindindin.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s1.r.c: Ƙimar dindindin n ce kawai, wato 7. Ba 8 ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s1.explain: Ma'aunin ninkawa na x shi ne n+1, ƙimar dindindin kuma n ce. Idan n=7, x²+8x+7 ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s2.model.0: Yayin da n ke ƙaruwa, ma'aunin ninkawa na kalmar x shi ne n+1, ƙimar dindindin kuma n; idan aka saka 7, ana samun 8 da 7.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-04.s.s2.model.1: A kowane misali ma'aunin ninkawa na x shi ne 3, 4, 5, wato n+1, ƙimar dindindin kuma n ne, saboda haka saka 7 yana bayar da 8 da 7.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-14.s.s2.model.0: Ma’aunin x 2, 4, 6 ne, ninki n sau 2; ƙayyadadden kalma 1, 4, 9 ne, wato n². Idan n=10, su ne 20 da 100.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-20.material: Tushen x²−5x+6=0 su ne 2 da 3. Tushen x²−7x+10=0 su ne 2 da 5. Tushen x²−8x+15=0 su ne 3 da 5. Nemo ƙa’idar tsakanin ma’aunai da tushen.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-20.s.s1.explain: Jimillar tushen biyu 9 ce, ninkawarsu 14. 2+7=9, 2×7=14; saboda haka tushen su ne 2 da 7.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-20.s.s2.model.0: A kowane misali, jimillar tushen biyu ita ce ma’aunin x bayan an sauya alama, ninkawarsu kuma ƙayyadadden kalma; saboda haka tushen su ne 2 da 7, jimilla 9, ninkawa 14.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-20.s.s2.model.1: Kamar yadda 5=2+3, 6=2×3, jimillar p ce, ninkawa q; saboda haka lambobi biyu masu jimilla 9, ninkawa 14, su ne 2 da 7.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-05.s.s1.r.b: Ukura n mu kare, si ugukuba n kabiri.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-05.s.s1.r.c: Ibice birimo x birakuraho, hasigara igice gihoraho −n².
l-m-h1-b0e01b-05.s.s1.explain: Ibice birimo x birakuraho, igice gihoraho kikaba −n². Niba n=8, ni x²−64.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-05.s.s2.model.0: Ibice bihoraho ni −1, −4, −9, ari byo −n²; bityo iyo n=8, ni −64 kandi imvugo ni x²−64.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-05.s.s2.model.1: Ibice birimo x birakuraho hasigara kare ya n gusa; bityo biba x²−8²=x²−64.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-06.s.s1.explain: Ku mibare kamere ibiri ikurikirana n na n+1, igiteranyo ni 2n+1 naho igiteranyo cy'imibare ni n(n+1). Niba n=5, ni 11 na 30.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.goal: Nemo ka bayyana ƙa'ida daga misalai da dama na adadin abubuwan haɗin saiti, sannan ka gwada ƙa'idar da sabon yanayi.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.material: An rubuta adadin abubuwan saiti A da B. Idan n(A)=3 da n(B)=4, n(A∪B)=7 idan n(A∩B)=0, 6 idan ya zama 1, 5 kuma idan ya zama 2. Idan n(A)=5, n(B)=6, n(A∩B)=2, menene n(A∪B)?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s1.r.b: Ka ƙara wani ɓangare ne kawai, kamar 5+2. Dole ne a cire 2 daga 5+6.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s1.r.c: Ka ƙara 2 da suka yi karo. A cikin misalan, yayin da haɗuwarsu ke ƙaruwa, adadin yana raguwa.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s1.r.d: Ka ƙara 5+6 kawai ba tare da cire ɓangaren haɗuwa 2 ba.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s1.explain: Ana ƙidaya abubuwan haɗuwa sau ɗaya kawai, saboda haka n(A∪B)=n(A)+n(B)−n(A∩B)=5+6−2=9.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s2.model.0: Duk lokacin da haɗuwar ta ƙaru da abu 1, haɗin saiti ya ragu da 1, don haka n(A)+n(B)−n(A∩B). 5+6−2=9.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-22.s.s2.model.1: Daga 3+4=7, haɗuwa ta 1 tana bayar da 6, ta 2 kuma 5; don haka a cire adadin abubuwan haɗuwa. Cire 2 daga 11, ya zama 9.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.material: Idan n(A)=5 kuma n(A∩B)=2, to n(A−B)=3. Idan n(A)=7 kuma n(A∩B)=3, to 4 ne. Idan n(A)=6 kuma n(A∩B)=0, to 6 ne. Idan n(A)=9 kuma n(A∩B)=4, menene n(A−B)?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s1.r.a: Ka yi ƙari kamar 9+4. A cikin misalan, adadin yana raguwa da yawan abubuwan da suka yi haɗuwa.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s1.r.c: Ka yi amfani da n(A∩B) yadda yake. A misalan, 3, 4, da 6 sun bambanta.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s1.r.d: Ka yi watsi da abubuwan da suka yi haɗuwa. Idan haɗuwar ita ce 4, adadin yana raguwa.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s1.explain: A−B shi ne A bayan an cire abubuwan da suka yi haɗuwa da B; saboda haka n(A)−n(A∩B)=9−4=5.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s2.model.0: Ana cire abubuwan A da suka yi haɗuwa da B; saboda haka n(A)−n(A∩B) ne. Wannan yana ba da 9−4=5.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-37.s.s2.model.1: 5−2=3, 7−3=4, da 6−0=6 duk suna aiki; saboda haka yin amfani da ƙa'ida ɗaya yana ba da 9−4=5.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-37.s.s1.prompt: Wane adadin lokuta ya dace ga jimillar 7 ko fiye?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-37.s.s1.r.a: Jimillar 7 ita kaɗai tana da hanyoyi 6 tuni, don haka hanyoyi 5 sun yi kaɗan.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-37.s.s1.explain: Jimillar 7 tana tsakiyar zangon, kuma 7 ko fiye hanyoyi 21 ne, kaɗan fiye da rabin 36.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-37.s.s2.model.0: Lokutan da jimillarsu ta kasa da 7 da waɗanda ta haura 7 kusan iri ɗaya ne, saboda haka ya ɗan fi rabin 36, wato 18, ko kusan hanyoyi 20.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-37.s.s2.model.1: Jimillar 7 ce ke da mafi yawan hanyoyi, wato 6, don haka 7 ko fiye sun ɗan fi rabin, kusan hanyoyi 20.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-44.material: Jefa kuɗi guda yana da hanya 2, fuska ko baya. Yi ƙiyasin adadin sakamako idan aka jefa kuɗi 6 lokaci guda.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-44.s.s1.r.a: Ba 2×6 ba ne. Ana ninka hanyoyin 2 na kowace tsabar kuɗi.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-44.s.s1.explain: Ninka 2 sau shida yana bada 2⁶=64 hanya. Haka nan ana iya ƙiyasta 8×8=64.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-44.s.s2.model.0: Kuɗi 3 suna da 2×2×2=8 hanya, kuɗi 6 kuma 8×8=64; kusan 60 ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-44.s.s2.model.1: Duk lokacin da aka ƙara tsabar kuɗi ɗaya, adadin yanayi yana ninkawa sau 2; saboda haka 64, wato ninkin 2 sau shida, daidai ne.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.title: Gereranya agaciro ka (x+2)(x−3) iyo x=0.1
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.goal: Gereranya agaciro ka (x+2)(x−3) iyo x ari 0.1, uhitemo ingano cyangwa intera ikwiye, usobanure impamvu.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.material: Gereranya agaciro ka (x+2)(x−3) iyo x yegereye 0.1, utabaze neza. Byafasha gufata x nka 0.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.s.s1.r.c: (x−3) ni mbi, bityo igisubizo cyo kugwiza na cyo kiba kibi.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.s.s1.r.d: Birasa n'aho wateranyije 2 na 3. Ugomba kugwiza.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.s.s1.explain: Niba x≈0, ubwo (0+2)(0−3)=−6. Agaciro nyako 2.1×(−2.9)=−6.09 na ko kari hafi ya −6.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.s.s2.model.0: Gufata x nka 0 bitanga 2×(−3)=−6, bityo hafi ya −6 ni byo.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-07.s.s2.model.1: Ibyiza bikubye ibibi bitanga igisubizo kibi, kandi ubunini bugereranyije ni 2×3; bityo ni hafi ya −6.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.title: Iyo uruhande rumwe rwiyongereyeho 1, ubuso bwa kare bwiyongera bungana iki?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.goal: Gereranya ubwinshi ubuso bwiyongeraho iyo uruhande rwa kare ruva kuri 20 rukagera kuri 21, uhitemo ingano cyangwa intera ikwiye, usobanure impamvu.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.material: Kare ifite uruhande rwa cm 20, rwongerwa rukaba cm 21. Gereranya ubwinshi ubuso bwiyongeraho wibuka ko (n+1)²=n²+2n+1.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s1.r.b: Iyo uruhande rwiyongereyeho 1, ubuso ntibwiyongeraho 1. Hiyongeraho imirongo ibiri ku mpande.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s1.r.c: Ibyo bibara umurongo umwe gusa wo ku ruhande (20). Hiyongeraho imirongo ibiri.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s1.r.d: Ibyo ni ubuso bw'ibanze, 20². Si ubwinshi bw'ubwiyongere.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s1.explain: (n+1)²−n²=2n+1; bityo iyo n=20, ni 41. Ubuso bwiyongera hafi y'imirongo ibiri yo ku mpande (20+20), umwe ku bugari n'undi ku burebure.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s2.model.0: Ubuso buba 441, burenga ubwa mbere 400 ho 41; bityo hafi ya cm² 40 ni byo.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-08.s.s2.model.1: Hiyongeraho umurongo wa 20 ku bugari n'undi wa 20 ku burebure, bityo bwiyongera hafi ya 40.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.title: Ni intera ingana iki ugereranyije kuva ku ntangiriro kugera kuri (5, 6)?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.goal: Gereranya intera iva ku ntangiriro y'ibipimo kugera kuri (5, 6), uhitemo ingano cyangwa intera ikwiye, usobanure impamvu.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.material: Ushaka kugereranya intera iva ku ntangiriro O kugera ku ngingo (5, 6) udakoresheje karahure. 5²+6²=61. 7²=49 na 8²=64.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s1.r.a: Yafashe igiteranyo cy'ubusumbane nk'uko kiri, ntiyafashe umuzi wa kare.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s1.r.b: Ibyo ni agaciro ko kureba koordinete imwe gusa. Ugomba gukoresha zombi.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s1.r.c: Koordinete zarateranyijwe, nka 5+6=11. Intera ni umuzi wa kare w'igiteranyo cy'ubusumbane.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s1.explain: Intera ni √61, kandi kubera ko 49<61<64, iri hagati ya 7 na 8 kandi yegereye 8.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s2.model.0: Intera ni √61, kandi kubera ko 7²=49 na 8²=64, 61 iri hagati yabyo. Bityo intera iri hagati ya 7 na 8.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-04.s.s2.model.1: 61 yegereye 64, bityo √61 iri munsi ya 8 ho gato, hafi ya 7.8. Ni yo mpamvu iri hagati ya 7 na 8.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.title: y = 3x − 7 ihurira he n'umurongo wa x?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.goal: Gereranya aho y=3x−7 ihurira n'umurongo wa x kugira ngo uhitemo ingano cyangwa intera ikwiye, usobanure impamvu.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.material: Gereranya koordinete ya x y'ingingo umurongo y=3x−7 uhuriraho n'umurongo wa x. Iyo x=2, y=−1; iyo x=3, y=2.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s1.prompt: Ugereranyije, koordinete ya x y'ingingo ihuriraho n'umurongo wa x ni iyihe?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s1.r.a: Iyo x=1, y=−4, bityo iracyari munsi y'umurongo wa x.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s1.r.c: −7 ni aho umurongo ukata ku murongo wa y. Wabyitiranyije n'aho ukata ku murongo wa x.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s1.r.d: Iyo x=3, y yamaze kuba nziza, bityo ihurira ku murongo mbere y'aho.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s1.explain: y ihinduka iva kuri mbi kuri x=2 ikaba nziza kuri x=3, bityo y=0 iri ahantu hagati.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s2.model.0: Iyo x=2, y=−1; iyo x=3, y=2, bityo ikimenyetso kirahinduka kandi umurongo uhurira n'umurongo wa x hagati yabyo.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-12.s.s2.model.1: Niba y=0, ubwo 3x=7, bityo x ni 7/3. Kubera ko 7/3 iri hagati ya 2 na 3, ihuriro riri hagati ya 2 na 3.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.title: Mu giteranyo cy'imvugo z'ubusumbane, ni iki gice kitari cyo?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.goal: Kurikirana intambwe ku yindi igisubizo cya (2x²−3x+1)+(x²+x−4), cyangwa uruhererekane rw'impamvu n'ingaruka, kugira ngo umenye aho cyatangiriye kwibeshya maze ubikosore.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s1.o.a: Aho igiteranyo cya x cyabazwe nka −3−1
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s1.r.c: Igisubizo cyandukuwe gusa mu mibare yabazwe mbere.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s1.o.d: Aho igiteranyo cya x² cyabazwe nka 2+1
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s1.explain: Ibice birimo x ni −3x+x; bityo umubare ubangikanye na x ni −3+1=−2. Igisubizo nyacyo ni 3x²−2x−3.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s2.model.0: Umubare ubangikanye na x ugomba kuba igiteranyo cya −3 na +1; bityo −3+1=−2.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-09.s.s2.model.1: Si byo kuko +x yakuweho nk'aho ari −x. Igisubizo nyacyo ni 3x²−2x−3.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-10.material: Igisubizo: ① Igice rusange cy'ibice byombi ni 2. ② Kugabanya buri gice na 2 bitanga x² na 2. ③ 2x²+4x=2(x²+2).

l-m-h1-b0e01b-10.s.s2.model.0: 4x igabanyijwe na 2 iba 2x, ariko yanditswe nka 2; bityo si byo. Iyo bikosowe, biba 2(x²+2x).

l-m-h1-b0e01b-23.goal: Bi maganin (x−3)(x+1)=0, ko jerin sanadi da sakamako, mataki-mataki domin nemo inda kuskure ya fara sannan ka gyara.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-23.s.s1.r.c: Ƙa’idar cewa idan ninkawa 0 ce, ɗaya daga cikin masu ninkawa 0 ne daidai ce.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-23.s.s1.o.d: Inda aka rubuta masu ninkawa a matsayin x−3 da x+1
l-m-h1-b0e01b-23.s.s1.r.d: Waɗannan su ne ainihin masu ninkawa kamar yadda aka bayar a matsalar.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-23.s.s1.explain: Idan x+1=0, to x=−1. Mafita daidai ita ce x=3 ko x=−1.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.material: Magani: Tun da x(x+3)=10, x=10 ko x+3=10. Saboda haka x=10 ko x=7.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.o.a: Inda aka samo x=7 daga x+3=10
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.r.a: Idan x+3=10, x=7 an lissafta daidai. Kuskuren yana matakin baya.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.o.b: Inda aka ce mafita biyu ne
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.r.b: Maganar cewa akwai mafita biyu ba ita ce matsalar ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.o.c: Inda aka ce tunda ninkawa 10 ce, ɗaya daga cikin masu ninkawa 10 ne
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.o.d: Inda aka tsara x(x+3)=10 a matsayin lissafi
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.r.d: An rubuta lissafin kamar yadda matsalar ta bayar, saboda haka daidai ne.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s1.explain: Masu ninkawa ba su da alaƙa da 0 sai idan ninkawarsu 0 ce. Daga x²+3x−10=0 da (x+5)(x−2)=0, x=−5 ko 2.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s2.model.0: Ko da ninkawa 10 ce, ba lallai ɗaya daga cikin masu ninkawa 10 ba ne; mayar da gefe ɗaya 0, a warware (x+5)(x−2)=0.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-24.s.s2.model.1: 2×5=10, saboda haka x=2 mafita ce, amma 2 ba ta cikin mafitar da aka samu; don haka mataki na farko ba daidai ba ne.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.title: Ese uburyo 60 bwo guhitamo abanyeshuri 3 bashinzwe isuku ni bwo?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.goal: Kurikirana intambwe ku yindi igisubizo cy'uburyo bwo guhitamo abanyeshuri 3 mu 5 bashinzwe isuku, cyangwa uruhererekane rw'impamvu n'ingaruka, kugira ngo umenye aho cyatangiriye kwibeshya maze ubikosore.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.material: Hitamo abanyeshuri 3 mu 5 bashinzwe isuku, utitaye ku rutonde. Igisubizo: uburyo 5 ku wa mbere, 4 ku wa kabiri, 3 ku wa gatatu; bityo 5×4×3=uburyo 60.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s1.r.a: Mu ntangiriro bose uko ari 5 bashobora gutoranywa, bityo uburyo 5 ni byo.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s1.r.b: Umuntu umwe amaze gutoranywa, hasigara 4, ibyo ni byo.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s1.r.c: Uburyo bwo kugwiza ni bwo. Ikibazo ni ugutandukanya urutonde.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s1.explain: Abanyeshuri 3 bamwe babarwa inshuro 6, nubwo urutonde rwonyine ari rwo ruhinduka. 60÷6=uburyo 10.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s2.model.0: Urutonde ntacyo rutwaye ku nshingano, bityo abantu 3 bamwe babarwa mu rutonde 6 zitandukanye; ni yo mpamvu 60÷6=10.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-40.s.s2.model.1: Icyo gisubizo cyafashe urutonde nk'aho rutandukanye, bityo ugabanye na 3×2×1=6 kugira ngo ukosore ubonemo uburyo 10.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.title: Mayar da x²+6x+9 zuwa ninkin dalilai
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.goal: Mayar da polinomi x²+6x+9 zuwa wata siga (furuci, tebur, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma'anarsu iri ɗaya.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.material: Kana son mayar da polinomi x²+6x+9 zuwa ninkin dalilai. Idan aka faɗaɗa sabon furucin, dole ya zama furucin asali.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s1.prompt: Wane furuci ne daidai da x²+6x+9?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s1.r.a: Idan aka faɗaɗa, zai zama x²+9x+18.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s1.r.b: Idan aka faɗaɗa, zai zama x²−9.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s1.r.d: Idan aka faɗaɗa, zai zama x²+10x+9.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s1.explain: (x+3)²=x²+6x+9. Hakan ne domin ƙayyadadden kalma 9=3², ma’aunin x kuma 6=2·3.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s2.model.0: Faɗaɗa (x+3)² yana bada x²+6x+9; saboda haka lissafin biyun suna da ma’ana ɗaya.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-12.s.s2.model.1: Ƙayyadadden kalma 9 ita ce 3², ma’aunin x, 6, kuma ninki 2 na 3 ne; saboda haka ya yi daidai da (x+3)².

l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.title: Mayar da mafita na lissafi zuwa bayanin jadawali
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.goal: Sake bayyana mafita na x²−x−6=0 ta wata sifa (lissafi, tebur, hoto ko kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma’anarsu iri ɗaya ce.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.material: x²−x−6=(x−3)(x+2), saboda haka mafita na x²−x−6=0 su ne 3 da −2. Faɗi waɗannan mafita bisa jadawalin aikin quadratic y=x²−x−6.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.prompt: Wanne ne ya bayyana mafita bisa jadawali?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.a: Ƙimar x ta wurin kololuwar jadawali
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.r.a: Kololuwa tana daidai tsakiyar mafita biyun, a x=0.5.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.b: Ƙimar y a wurin da jadawalin ya haɗu da axis y
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.r.b: Wurin haɗuwa da axis y ƙimar x=0 ce, wato −6.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.c: Ƙimar x na wuraren da jadawalin ya haɗu da axis x
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.o.d: Yawan wuraren da jadawalin ya ratsa
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.r.d: Yawan wurare ba shi da alaƙa da mafita.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s1.explain: Ƙimar x inda y=0 ita ce mafita na lissafin. Su ne ƙimar x na maki (3,0) da (−2,0) inda jadawalin ya haɗu da axis x.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s2.model.0: Lissafin x²−x−6=0 yanayin y=0 ne; saboda haka ƙimar x na maki da jadawalin ya haɗu da axis x su ne mafita.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-22.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka saka x=3, y=0; saboda haka maki (3,0) yana kan jadawalin. Wannan ya sa mafita ita ce ƙimar x na wurin haɗuwa da axis x.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.title: Bayyana y=2x−4 da kalmomi
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.goal: Mayar da aikin layi y=2x−4 zuwa wata siga (daidaito, tebur, hoto, kalmomi), sannan ka bayyana dalilin da ya sa ma'anar iri ɗaya ce.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.material: Muna son bayyana aikin layi y=2x−4 da kalmomi maimakon daidaito. Ka yi tunanin ma'anar gangara da y-intercept.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.prompt: Wace bayani ce take da ma'ana iri ɗaya da daidaiton?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.o.a: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1, y yana ƙaruwa da 2; idan x=0, y=−4.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.o.b: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1, y yana raguwa da 4; idan x=0, y=2.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.r.b: Ka musanya wuraren gangara da y-intercept.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.o.c: Idan x ya ƙaru da 1, y yana ƙaruwa da 2; idan x=0, y=4.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.o.d: Idan x ya ƙaru da 2, y yana ƙaruwa da 1; idan x=0, y=−4.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.r.d: Ka karanta gangara 2 juye a matsayin 1/2.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s1.explain: Gangara 2 na nufin y yana ƙaruwa da 2 idan x ya ƙaru da 1; y-intercept −4 kuma shi ne darajar y idan x=0.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s2.model.0: Gangara 2 na nufin y yana ƙaruwa da 2 idan x ya ƙaru da 1, kuma y-intercept −4 shi ne y idan x=0, saboda haka ma'anarsu iri ɗaya ce.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-14.s.s2.model.1: Saka x=0 yana bayar da y=−4, saka x=1 kuma yana bayar da y=−2. Ya ƙaru da 2, saboda haka bayanin kalmomi ya dace da daidaiton.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.prompt: Wane ne ya yi daidai, kuma me ya sa?
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.o.a: B: Idan y-intercept ya bambanta, daga ƙarshe za su haɗu
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.r.a: Suna haɗuwa idan gangararsu ta bambanta. Idan gangara ɗaya ce, tazarar ta tsaya yadda take.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.o.b: A: A x iri ɗaya, y koyaushe yana bambanta da 4, saboda haka ba sa haɗuwa.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.o.c: A da B duka sun yi daidai
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.r.c: “suna haɗuwa” da “ba sa haɗuwa” ba za su iya zama daidai duka ba.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.o.d: B: Idan gangararsu ɗaya ce, layi ɗaya ne koyaushe
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.r.d: Idan y-intercept ya bambanta, layuka ne daban-daban.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s1.explain: A x iri ɗaya, bambancin ƙimar y biyun (2x+1)−(2x−3)=4 ne, koyaushe haka yake. Saboda haka ba sa haɗuwa.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s2.model.0: Bambancin ƙimar y a x iri ɗaya koyaushe 4 ne, saboda haka layukan ba sa haɗuwa. A daidai ne.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-15.s.s2.model.1: Warware 2x+1=2x−3 yana bayar da 1=−3, wanda ba shi da mafita, saboda haka ba sa haɗuwa. Idan gangararsu ɗaya ce, layukan suna layi ɗaya.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.material: Jadawalin y=x²−2x−3: idan x ya zama −1, 0, 1, 2, 3, y ya zama 0, −3, −4, −3, 0. Ɗalibi A: Mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jadawalin, −4, ita ce mafi ƙaranci. Ɗalibi B: Idan x=0, y=−3 ita ce mafi ƙaranci.

l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s1.r.a: Mafi ƙarancin ƙima ita ce mafi ƙaranci.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s1.o.b: B: Y-intercept idan x=0 ita ce mafi ƙarancin ƙima
l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s1.r.b: Idan x=1, ƙimar ita ce −4, wadda ta fi −3 ƙanƙanta.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s1.o.c: Warwarewar biyun suna ba da ƙima iri ɗaya

l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s1.explain: A cikin jadawali, idan x=1, y=−4 ne; wannan ya fi −3 ƙanƙanta idan x=0. Zanen yana buɗewa zuwa sama, saboda haka mafi ƙarancin wuri shi ne mafi ƙarancin ƙima.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s2.model.0: Sanya x=1 yana ba da 1−2−3=−4, wanda ya fi −3 idan x=0 ƙanƙanta; saboda haka −3 ba mafi ƙarancin ƙima ba ne. A ya yi daidai.
l-m-h1-b0e02a-45.s.s2.model.1: Ga zanen da ke buɗewa zuwa sama, wurin mafi ƙasa shi ne mafi ƙaranci; saboda haka mafi ƙarancin ƙimar jadawali, −4, ita ce mafi ƙaranci.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-24.s.s2.model.1: Mutane 8 za su ci won 21,000, wanda ya wuce kasafin kuɗi, saboda haka mafi yawan da suka cika sharuɗɗa mutane 7 ne.

Teburin mako na biyu yana da Litinin, Talata, Laraba a matsayin layuka da shaguna 2 a matsayin ginshiƙai (3×2). Ka riƙe tsarin littafin lissafi (layuka = shaguna).
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.prompt: Wace hanya ce ta cika dukkan sharuɗɗan?
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.r.a: 2×3 da 3×2 siffofi ne daban-daban, saboda haka ba za a iya haɗa su ba.

l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.r.b: Abubuwan za su shiga sel ɗin shaguna da ranaku marasa dacewa, don haka ma'anar za ta zama ba daidai ba.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.o.c: Sake tsara teburin mako na biyu ta yadda layuka = shaguna, ginshiƙai = ranaku, sannan a haɗa
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.o.d: Canza teburin mako na farko ya zama layuka = ranaku, sannan a haɗa
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.r.d: Tsarin littafin lissafi na layuka = shaguna zai lalace.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s1.explain: Dole siffofin su zama iri ɗaya kafin a haɗa su, kuma kowane sel ɗaya ya wakilci shago da rana ɗaya.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s2.model.0: Idan aka sake tsara teburin mako na biyu ya zama layuka = shaguna, zai zama 2×3 kamar na farko; saboda haka za a iya haɗa su kuma a kiyaye tsarin littafin lissafi. Wannan ne ya sa wannan hanyar ta dace.
l-m-h1-b0e01a-55.s.s2.model.1: Idan aka matsar da sel kawai, shaguna da ranaku za su gauraya; saboda haka dole a sake tsara su tare da kiyaye ma'anar bayanan.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-15.s.s2.model.1: Niba x=7, ubuso bw'inzira ni 32, burenze 28; bityo x=6 ni yo itanga akarima kanini kurusha ibindi ku buryo yujuje ibisabwa.

l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.goal: Ku mvugo y'ubusumbane x²+bx+c ishobora gufindurwa, suzuma ibisabwa byose bidahuye, uhitemo ubwumvikane bukwiye kurushaho, usobanure impamvu.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.material: Tuma x²+bx+c ifinduka nka (x+p)(x+q). Ibisabwa: p na q ni imibare kamere itandukanye, b ntirenza 8, kandi c iba nini bishoboka.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s1.prompt: Ni iyihe mvugo ikwiye kurushaho ku bisabwa?
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s1.r.a: Ni (x+4)², bityo p na q birangana, binyuranyije n'ibisabwa.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s1.r.d: Ya cika sharudda amma c=12 ya gaza 15.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s1.explain: (x+3)(x+5)=x²+8x+15 yana da p≠q, b≤8, c=15 kuma shi ne mafi girma; ya cika sharudda.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s2.model.0: Idan p=3 da q=5, to b=8, c=15, p≠q; saboda haka ya cika sharudda kuma c shi ne mafi girma.
l-m-h1-b0e01b-16.s.s2.model.1: 4 da 4 ba a yarda da su ba domin p da q iri ɗaya ne; daga lambobi mabambanta masu jimilla aƙalla 8, 3 da 5 suna da ninkawa mafi girma, saboda haka su ne daidai.
